text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh~~...! 1st place again!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeeeew!! Falco-chan is the strongest!! 
The ultimate Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, she really might just take 1st place 
in every single one...!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gooooooo for it! Oooooh, Falcooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh, Falco~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not enough. I can't reach 
that sight...”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I need to push it a bit further 
and create a moment that really hypes up 
the crowd during the live..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You've got a stern look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah... um.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! After all, it's too early to 
take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There are still races that I have to win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next is the JBC Classic. Girls should 
start gunning specifically for Falco 
around now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can't lose...!
And then, an unexpected visitor arrived—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Y-You're...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Madam President...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Smart Falcon. Sorry for 
bothering you right after your race.

Symboli Rudolf, Student Council President 
of Tracen Academy. An absolute sovereign 
whose name is etched in history as a 
Triple Tiara/Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, what's wrong? Did Falco do 
something...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is this about handing out flyers on the 
roof? Or the live show in the staff 
room...? Ugh, there are too many things it 
could be...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't be so intimidated. 
Today... I came to show my appreciation 
for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: First, congratulations. And... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As student council president, I was 
already well aware of the talk surrounding 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the victory declaration of 
"taking 1st place in everything," the dirt 
racing scene has been buzzing with 
excitement. I hear attendance at the races 
is soaring, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As someone who wishes for the advancement 
of the Umamusume world, and as an 
Umamusume myselfâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to express my gratitude for 
your hard work. I look forward to seeing 
your versatile talents shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—I never imagined... that the student 
council president herself would thank 
me...
choice_data_list: You're getting results to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see... I wonder if that's true.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then I've got to work even harder! I want 
to live up to the President's 
expectations!

Having received praise from Symboli 
Rudolf, Smart Falcon is fired up in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not enough. I can't reach 
that sight...”

Her tense, eager demeanor right after the 
race is concerning, but now isn't the time 
to pour cold water on her. Thinking that—
choice_data_list: Let's win the next JBC Classic too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse☆ I mean... we just gotta win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give it my all~! Yeah! ☆
